brief:
Shehab Wire reported on a discussion addressing the scale of suffering experienced by Gaza's population, noting that pain has become pervasive among residents of all ages. The piece compares the psychological toll to a virus, spreading sighs across tent encampments and neighborhoods throughout the territory.

The commentary acknowledges widespread recognition of Gaza's humanitarian crisis while exploring shared human dimensions of suffering across divided communities.

title: Arab writers, Hebrew hearts debate Gaza suffering
